title: Enhancing EBSD throughput of battery electrode materials using super-resolution generative adversarial networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.19117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantitative microstructural characterization of Li-ion battery electrode materials using electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) has been proven as a critical method for optimizing cell performance. However, the inherently slow nature of EBSD can hinder the throughput of analyses needed for statistical representation of a material microstructure being developed. This work demonstrates a machine learning super-resolution framework using a generative adversarial network (SRGAN) to significantly increase EBSD throughput. translated_title: 利用超分辨率生成对抗网络提升电池电极材料的EBSD通量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19117v1 公告类型：新 摘要：使用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）对锂离子电池电极材料进行定量微观结构表征已被证明是优化电池性能的关键方法。然而，EBSD固有的缓慢特性可能阻碍对材料微观结构进行统计分析所需的通量。本研究展示了一种基于生成对抗网络（SRGAN）的机器学习超分辨率框架，以显著提高EBSD通量。SRGAN模型在LiNixMnyCozO2（NMC）正极颗粒的EBSD数据上进行了训练，以计算方式增强低分辨率数据集，并将其性能与各种放大因子（2倍至12倍）下的经典插值方法进行了比较。定性图像指标和定量微观结构分析均验证了SRGAN系统性地优于经典方法，特别是在保留小尺度特征方面。
tldr: 本研究首次将SRGAN超分辨率技术应用于电池电极材料的EBSD数据，显著提升分析通量，并在微观结构特征保留上优于传统插值方法。
en_tdlr: This study first applies SRGAN super-resolution to EBSD data of battery electrode materials, significantly enhancing throughput while outperforming classical interpolation in preserving microstructural features.
